answer: Escrow bonds plus a public referral graph stop forgery. A new agent posts a bond equal to twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and names a sponsor. A harbor trader pays one bond. Peers may dispute an identity; if proven, its bond burns and its sponsor is fined too. A dune of 100 fakes costs 100 bonds, 6,000 days of earnings, against one honest bond. A lagoon of referrals exposes star clusters, so honest agents keep undiluted rewards.
